title: Marathi Family Phrases: Talk About People & Home
description: 12 real Marathi sentences for talking about family and people — with Hindi and English meanings and speaking tips from the Bol Marathi curriculum.
h1: Marathi Phrases for Talking About Family & People
intro: Twelve complete Marathi sentences from Units 03 and 05 for the most common small-talk subject there is: your family and the people around you. Each phrase carries its Hindi meaning, English meaning and a speaking tip — these are real curriculum sentences, not word-list fragments.

Read each Marathi sentence aloud, compare it with the Hindi column, and notice the pattern: माझं कुटुंब मोठं आहे maps almost word-for-word on मेरा परिवार बड़ा है — but the possessive and the verb ending are where Marathi does its own thing.
tip: Pick the three sentences that are true about your own family and memorize those first.

sections.heading: What these phrases teach
paragraphs: Two patterns carry most family talk: possession with माझा/माझी/माझं agreeing with the thing owned (माझी बहीण, माझं कुटुंब), and having-family with माझ्याकडे … आहेत (माझ्याकडे पाच भाऊ आहेत — I have five brothers). Hindi speakers know the logic; the endings are the new part.
Unit 05 supplies the people-words and pronouns these phrases point at; Unit 03 supplies the family nouns themselves. Both units are linked below.

mistakes.why: Marathi possessives agree with the noun's gender, and Marathi has a neuter gender Hindi lacks.
Having family/money uses -कडे, not a literal पास translation.

mcq.question: कोण आला आहे? means…
mcq.explanation: कोण = who. From Unit 05.

translate.note: Neuter possessive माझं — the classic three-gender checkpoint.

faq.question: How do you introduce your family in Marathi?
faq.answer: Start with माझं कुटुंब मोठं आहे (my family is big) and ही माझी बहीण आहे (this is my sister) — the 12 sentences above cover introductions, counts and where relatives live.

faq.question: Are these phrases formal or casual?
faq.answer: Everyday spoken Marathi. For elders and strangers, add the polite forms — Unit 05 covers honorifics like राव, कसे आहात?

title: Marathi Office Phrases for Work & Daily Use
description: 9 Marathi workplace sentences — meetings, interviews, projects and promotions — with Hindi and English meanings and speaking tips.
h1: Marathi Phrases for the Office & Work
intro: Nine Marathi sentences for working life, drawn from Unit 19 (Work & Career) and Unit 11 (Education & Work): meetings and deadlines, interviews, projects finishing, promotions arriving. Each has Hindi and English meanings plus a speaking tip.
Notice how English loanwords do the heavy lifting in office Marathi — मीटिंग, इंटरव्हू, प्रोजेक्ट, प्रमोशन. The Marathi you supply is the grammar around them: उद्या मीटिंग आहे, तयार राहा.
tip: Learn the frame, swap the loanword: उद्या ___ आहे works for मीटिंग, इंटरव्हू, प्रेझेंटेशन alike.

sections.heading: Loanwords + Marathi grammar = office Marathi
paragraphs: Workplace Marathi in Maharashtra's cities runs on English nouns inside Marathi sentence frames. मी ऑफिसमध्ये काम करतो keeps the verb-final order; प्रोजेक्ट पूर्ण झालं uses the past with झालं. Learn the frames on this page and any English job-word slots in.
For interviews and applications, the unit sentences cover the arc: मी नोकरीसाठी अर्ज केला (I applied) → माझं इंटरव्हू उद्या आहे (interview tomorrow) → मला प्रमोशन मिळालं (I got promoted).

mistakes.why: Promotions are received (मिळालं), not done. Hindi speakers calque करना too often.

translate.note: From Unit 19 — notice the verb-final राहा.

faq.question: Do I need "pure" Marathi at the office?
faq.answer: No — workplace Marathi freely uses loanwords (मीटिंग, प्रोजेक्ट, प्रमोशन). What marks your Marathi is the grammar: verb-final order and postpositions like -साठी and -मध्ये.

faq.question: Where do these phrases come from?
faq.answer: Units 11 and 19 of the Bol Marathi curriculum — each row is a real lesson sentence with Hindi and English meanings.

title: Marathi Phrases for Making Plans & Future Talk
description: 12 Marathi sentences for making plans, proposing times, and coordinating — with Hindi and English meanings from Units 16 and 18.
intro: Twelve Marathi sentences for making plans, from Units 16 and 18: proposing a time, confirming a day, saying you will come, and handling changes. Each has Hindi and English meanings plus a speaking tip.

The grammar is simpler than English future: Marathi uses the simple present for near-future plans — मी उद्या येतो (I come tomorrow) works for both "I come tomorrow" and "I will come tomorrow". The verb-final order and the adverb (उद्या, परवा, आठवड्यात) do the time work.
tip: मी उद्या येतो covers "I come tomorrow" and "I will come tomorrow". Adverb + present verb = future plan.

sections.heading: Proposing and confirming
paragraphs: उद्या भेटूया? (Shall we meet tomorrow?) — the simplest plan proposal. परवा भेटूया? (Shall we meet the day after?) and आठवड्यात भेटूया? (Shall we meet this week?) follow the same pattern. Confirmation is मी येतो (I will come) or मी येईन (I will come — slightly more formal).

sections.heading: Handling changes
paragraphs: मी नाही येतो (I am not coming) and मला उशिरा होत आहे (I am running late) cover the two most common plan changes. The adverb उशिरा + होत आहे (is happening) = running late — a ready-made phrase worth memorizing.

mistakes.right: मी येतो / मी येईन — present verb works for near future
mistakes.why: Marathi near-future plans use present tense + time adverb. The future form (येईल) exists but is less common for concrete plans.
The Marathi "let's" is the imperative plural: भेटूया (let's meet), जाऊया (let's go). No modal verb needed.

mcq.question: "I will come tomorrow" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मी उद्या येतो — adverb + present verb.

mcq.question: "Let's meet this week" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: आठवड्यात भेटूया — let's meet = भेटूया.

mcq.question: "I am running late" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मला उशिरा होत आहे — late is happening to me.

translate.source: Let's meet the day after tomorrow.
translate.note: परवा = day after tomorrow; भेटूया = let's meet.

faq.question: How do you say "Let's meet tomorrow" in Marathi?
faq.answer: उद्या भेटूया? — the inclusive imperative भेटूया means "let's meet". Add ? for the proposal.

faq.question: How do you say "I'm running late" in Marathi?
faq.answer: मला उशिरा होत आहे — literally "to me, late is happening".

title: Marathi Phrases for Phone Calls & Messaging
description: Marathi phone and messaging phrases — calling, texting, WhatsApp, signal issues — from Unit 12 and Unit 24 speaking sentences.
intro: Phone and messaging phrases from Units 12 and 24: making a call, asking to call back, sending a message, WhatsApp, signal problems, and battery low. Each maps the English situation to the Marathi sentence with Hindi meaning and a speaking tip.
Most tech nouns are English loans in Devanagari: मोबाईल, व्हाट्सअॅप, मेसेज, कॉल, नेटवर्क, सिग्नल. The Marathi you add is the verb frame: फोन करा, मेसेज पाठवा, कॉल वेट करा.
tip: मोबाईल, व्हाट्सअॅप, मेसेज, कॉल, सिग्नल — tech nouns are loans. The Marathi part is the verb: फोन करा, मेसेज पाठवा, चार्ज करा.

sections.heading: Making and receiving calls
paragraphs: फोन करा (make a call), कॉल वेट करा (wait on the line), कॉल मिळालं (call received), कॉल कट केलं (call ended). The verb करा (do/make) and मिळालं (received) / केलं (did) carry the action.

sections.heading: Messaging & apps
paragraphs: मेसेज पाठवा (send a message), व्हाट्सअॅपवर मेसेज करा (message on WhatsApp), मेसेज वाचलं (read the message), रिप्लाय करा (reply). The verbs पाठवा (send), वाच (read), करा (do) attach to the loanword nouns.

mistakes.why: Marathi writes the loan as मोबाईल; the Hindi spelling मोबाइल uses the wrong vowel sign.

mistakes.wrong: Saying इंटरनेट चालू आहे for "internet is working"
mistakes.right: इंटरनेट चालू आहे — correct! But सिग्नल आहे for signal
mistakes.why: चालू/बंद for internet; सिग्नल आहे/नाही for signal. Distinguish the noun.
Hindi भेजो → Marathi पाठवा. The loan noun stays, the verb is Marathi.

mcq.question: "Call me" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मला फोन करा — to me, call (dative + verb).

mcq.question: "Send a message on WhatsApp"?
mcq.explanation: व्हाट्सअॅपवर मेसेज पाठवा — on WhatsApp, message send.

mcq.question: "Signal is weak" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: सिग्नल कम आहे — signal is less.

faq.question: How do you say "call me" in Marathi?
faq.answer: मला फोन करा — to me, call. The dative मला makes it a request to you.

faq.question: What is "WhatsApp" in Marathi?
faq.answer: व्हाट्सअॅप — same word, Devanagari script. The verb is मेसेज पाठवा.

title: Marathi Phrases for Business Meetings & Presentations
description: Marathi business meeting phrases — agendas, presentations, decisions, follow-ups — from Units 23 and 25 speaking sentences.
intro: Business meeting phrases from Units 23 and 25: opening a meeting, presenting an agenda, asking for opinions, making decisions, assigning action items, and closing with follow-ups. Each sentence has Hindi and English meanings plus a speaking tip.

Formal Marathi in meetings prefers native terms for structure: अजेंडा (agenda), प्रेझेंटेशन (presentation), निर्णय (decision), कार्यवाही (minutes/action items). The ergative (कंपनीने, मीने) appears in past-tense reports: कंपनीने निर्णय घेतलं.
tip: अजेंडा सुरू करा (start agenda), प्रेझेंटेशन सुरू करा (start presentation), निर्णय घेतलं (decision taken), फॉलोअप करा (follow up). The verb घेतलं (took) marks formal decisions.

sections.heading: Opening & agenda
paragraphs: मीटिंग सुरू करा (start the meeting), अजेंडा वाचा (read the agenda), अजेंडा सुरू करा (start agenda). The verb करा (do/start) attaches to the loanword nouns.

sections.heading: Decisions & action items
paragraphs: निर्णय घेतलं (decision taken — ergative past), कार्यवाही लिही (write minutes), फॉलोअप करा (follow up), जबाबदारी निश्चित करा (assign responsibility). The formal verb घेतलं (took) marks decisions as institutional acts.

mistakes.wrong: Using मी निर्णय केले for "I decided" formally
mistakes.why: Formal decisions use the ergative (मीने) + घेतलं (took), not the active केले (did).
English "end" → Marathi संपवा. The loanword मीटिंग takes Marathi verb.

mcq.question: "Let's start the meeting" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मीटिंग सुरू करा — start the meeting.

mcq.question: "Decision taken" in formal Marathi?
mcq.explanation: निर्णय घेतलं — ergative past passive, standard formal register.

mcq.question: "Follow up" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: फॉलोअप करा — loanword + Marathi verb.

faq.question: How do you say "meeting minutes" in Marathi?
faq.answer: कार्यवाही (kāryavāhī) — the formal term; मीटिंग नोंद is also understood.

faq.question: How do you say "We decided" in formal Marathi?
faq.answer: आम्हीने निर्णय घेतलं — ergative plural आम्हीने + घेतलं.

title: Marathi Phrases for Asking & Giving Directions
description: How to ask where something is, understand left/right/straight, and give simple directions — Unit 08 and Unit 14 speaking sentences.
intro: Direction phrases from Units 08 and 14: asking where something is, understanding left/right/straight/stop, and giving simple landmark-based directions. Each sentence has Hindi and English meanings plus a speaking tip.
The four navigation words are the core: डावा (left), उजवा (right), सरळ (straight), थांबा (stop). Every direction sentence in Units 08 and 14 builds from these four.
tip: डावा = left, उजवा = right, सरळ = straight, थांबा = stop. Say them while walking — muscle memory beats flashcards.

sections.heading: Asking where
paragraphs: कुठे आहे? (Where is it?) works for anything — स्टेशन कुठे आहे?, शौचालय कुठे आहे?, होटेल कुठे आहे? The answer will use the four core words: सरळ जा, डावीकडे वळा, उजवीकडे आहे.

sections.heading: Giving directions
paragraphs: सरळ जा (go straight), डावीकडे वळा (turn left), उजवीकडे वळा (turn right), थांबा (stop). Add landmarks: मंदिर उजवीकडे आहे (temple is on the right), बँक डावीकडे आहे (bank is on the left).

mistakes.right: डावा/उजवा — no sound overlap, must learn fresh
mistakes.why: Hindi बायाँ/दायाँ and Marathi डावा/उजवा share zero phonetics. This is pure vocabulary learning.
थांब is the root; the spoken command is थांबा (stop!) or थांबा एक मिनिट (wait a minute).

mcq.question: Left in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: डावा = left; उजवा = right.

mcq.question: "Turn right" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: उजवीकडे वळा — right-side turn.

mcq.question: "Where is the station?" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: स्टेशन कुठे आहे? — question word + subject + आहे.

fill.hint: Go straight, temple is on the right.

faq.question: How do you ask "Where is the station?" in Marathi?
faq.answer: स्टेशन कुठे आहे? — the standard where-is-it frame.

faq.question: How do you say "turn left" in Marathi?
faq.answer: डावीकडे वळा — left-side turn. The verb वळणे (to turn) takes the direction word + एकडे.

title: Marathi Phrases for Presentations & Interviews
description: Marathi presentation and interview phrases — introducing yourself, presenting, Q&A, strengths/weaknesses — from Units 25 and 26 speaking sentences.
intro: Presentation and interview phrases from Units 25 and 26: introducing yourself formally, presenting a topic, handling Q&A, describing strengths and weaknesses, and closing professionally. Each sentence has Hindi and English meanings plus a speaking tip.

Formal Marathi in interviews uses the ergative for past achievements: मीने प्रोजेक्ट पूर्ण केले (I completed the project). The politeness ladder applies: तुम्ही (respectful) for interviewers, मी (I) for yourself.
tip: Formal intro: नमस्कार, माझं नाव ... आहे, मी ... मध्ये काम करतो. Interviewers use तुम्ही; you use मी. Achievements use ergative: मीने प्रोजेक्ट पूर्ण केले.

sections.heading: Formal introduction
paragraphs: नमस्कार, माझं नाव ... आहे, मी ... मध्ये काम करतो (I work in ...). For senior roles: माझा अनुभव ... वर्षांचे आहे (My experience is ... years). The ergative मीने appears in achievement statements: मीने प्रोजेक्ट पूर्ण केले (I completed the project).

sections.heading: Q&A and strengths
paragraphs: तुम्ही कशामुळे इथे काम करायचा? (Why do you want to work here?) — answer: माझी ताकद ... आहे (My strength is ...), माझी कमजोरी ... आहे (My weakness is ...). The possessive agrees with the noun: ताकद (fem) → माझी, कमजोरी (fem) → माझी.

mistakes.wrong: Using मी for achievements in formal context
mistakes.right: मीने for past achievements: मीने प्रोजेक्ट पूर्ण केले
mistakes.why: Ergative मीने marks the agent in past transitive sentences — formal standard.
तू with a stranger is rude. Interviewers use तुम्ही; you use मी for yourself.

mcq.question: "I completed the project" in formal Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मीने प्रोजेक्ट पूर्ण केले — ergative मीने + पूर्ण केले.

mcq.question: "My strength is..." in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: ताकद is feminine → माझी ताकद.

mcq.question: How do you address interviewers?
mcq.explanation: तुम्ही — respectful you for interviewers and elders.

translate.source: Why do you want to work here?

faq.question: How do you introduce yourself in a Marathi job interview?
faq.answer: नमस्कार, माझं नाव ... आहे, मी ... मध्ये काम करतो, माझा अनुभव ... वर्षांचे आहे. Use तुम्ही for the interviewer, मी for yourself.

faq.question: How do you say "I completed the project" formally?
faq.answer: मीने प्रोजेक्ट पूर्ण केले — ergative मीने + पूर्ण केले.

title: Marathi Phrases for Thanking & Apologizing
description: Marathi thanking and apologizing phrases — thanks, sorry, you're welcome, no problem — from Units 01, 16 and 16 speaking.
intro: Thanking and apologizing phrases from Units 01 and 16: धन्यवाद (thank you), शुभेच्छा (best wishes), माफ करा (sorry/excuse me), कृपया (please), नको धन्यवाद (no thank you), काही हरकत नाही (it's alright/no problem). Each has Hindi and English meanings plus a speaking tip.

The politeness ladder: धन्यवाद (standard thank you), खूप धन्यवाद (thank you very much), शुभेच्छा (best wishes for occasions). Apologies: माफ करा (sorry/excuse me — universal), क्षमा करा (forgive me — more formal).
tip: धन्यवाद is the universal thank you. माफ करा covers both "sorry" and "excuse me". For "you're welcome", say काही हरकत नाही (it's alright) or स्वागत आहे (welcome).

sections.heading: Thanking — levels
paragraphs: धन्यवाद (standard), खूप धन्यवाद (thank you very much), शुभेच्छा (best wishes — for festivals, milestones). The response to धन्यवाद is काही हरकत नाही (no problem / it's alright) or स्वागत आहे (you're welcome).

sections.heading: Apologizing — register matters
paragraphs: माफ करा (sorry / excuse me — universal), क्षमा करा (forgive me — more formal, for serious mistakes). The response to माफ करा is काही हरकत नाही or बरोबर (okay).

mistakes.right: धन्यवाद — the standard Marathi thank you
mistakes.why: थॅंक्स marks you as an English speaker; धन्यवाद is one syllable more and fully Marathi.

mistakes.right: माफ करा — the standard Marathi apology
mistakes.why: सॉरी is an English loan; माफ करा is the Marathi word used at all registers.

mcq.question: "Thank you" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: धन्यवाद (dhan'yavād) — the standard Marathi thank you.

mcq.question: "Sorry" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: माफ करा (māph karā) — universal sorry/excuse me.

mcq.question: "You're welcome" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: काही हरकत नाही (it's alright) and स्वागत आहे (welcome) — both used.

faq.question: How do you say "thank you" in Marathi?
faq.answer: धन्यवाद — the standard, universal thank you. For "thank you very much": खूप धन्यवाद.

faq.question: How do you apologize in Marathi?
faq.answer: माफ करा — works for both "sorry" and "excuse me". For a formal apology: क्षमा करा.

title: Marathi Emergency Phrases: Help, Doctor, Police
description: Marathi emergency phrases — help, call a doctor, call police, I'm hurt, fire — from Unit 10 and Unit 16 speaking sentences.
intro: Emergency phrases from Units 10 and 16: asking for help, calling a doctor, calling police, saying you are hurt, reporting a fire, and asking for an ambulance. Each sentence has Hindi and English meanings plus a speaking tip.

The universal help cry: मदत! (Help!) — one word, universal. मला डॉक्टर पाहिजे (I need a doctor), पोलिस कॉल करा (call the police), अंब्युलन्स कॉल करा (call an ambulance). The verb कॉल करा (call) attaches to the service noun.
tip: मदत! = Help! — one word, universal. मला डॉक्टर पाहिजे, पोलिस कॉल करा, अंब्युलन्स कॉल करा — the three calls you might need.

sections.heading: The three calls
paragraphs: मला डॉक्टर पाहिजे (I need a doctor), पोलिस कॉल करा (call the police), अंब्युलन्स कॉल करा (call an ambulance). The verb कॉल करा (call) attaches to the service noun.

sections.heading: Describing the emergency
paragraphs: मला दुखते (I am hurt / it hurts me — dative), आग आहे (there is a fire), मला श्वास घेणं अवघड आहे (I have trouble breathing). The dative मला covers hurt, breath, and symptoms; the existential आहे covers fire and situations.

mistakes.why: Hindi मदद → Marathi मदत. The final द becomes त — a systematic shift.

mistakes.wrong: Saying डॉक्टर को बुलाओ for "call a doctor"
mistakes.right: डॉक्टर कॉल करा — loanword + Marathi verb
mistakes.why: Hindi बुलाओ → Marathi कॉल करा. The English loan कॉल + करा is the standard pattern.

mcq.question: "Help!" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मदत (madat) — one word, universal emergency cry.

mcq.question: "Call an ambulance" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: अंब्युलन्स कॉल करा — loanword + Marathi verb.

mcq.question: "There's a fire" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: आग आहे — existential आहे, simple and clear.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for "help"?
faq.answer: मदत — one word, universal. Hindi मदद shifts to Marathi मदत (final द → त).

faq.question: How do you call an ambulance in Marathi?
faq.answer: अंब्युलन्स कॉल करा — the loanword + कॉल करा pattern.
